export type Message = {
  id: string
  role: "user" | "assistant" | "tool"
  text: string
  toolCalls: Array<{ id: string; name: string; arguments: Record<string, unknown> }>
}

export type SessionSnapshot = {
  sessionId: string
  transcript: Message[]
  lastEventSeq: number
}

export type SessionEvent = {
  eventSeq: number
  type: string
  runId: string
  message?: Message
  messageId?: string
  text?: string
  toolCallId?: string
  toolName?: string
  status?: string
  arguments?: Record<string, unknown>
  result?: string
  permissionId?: string
  revision?: number
  outcome?: string
}
